findings.consequence: Normal cleanup and storage status do not print snapshot paths, so the reader cannot complete the restore command from the described results.

findings.disposition: Added explicit snapshot locations and journal discovery instructions in both languages.

findings.problem: The review procedure omits committing source changes before review and attestation.
findings.consequence: A maintainer following the written sequence hits a hard gate refusal with uncommitted article edits.
findings.evidence: Confirmed by knowledge/scripts/review-check.mjs:55-59: any dirty path outside .review/attestations throws Commit the source changes before reviewing or pushing.
findings.disposition: Corrected in both languages after the frozen third-round findings.
findings.verification: Both versions at line123 explicitly require committing source/article changes before attestation, while retaining separate attestation commit afterward.

findings.problem: The attest instruction does not provide or link the accepted results JSON shape.
findings.consequence: The prose finding fields cannot be turned into an accepted report without reverse-engineering the validator.
findings.evidence: Confirmed: review-check.mjs:64-72 treats the file as a perAgent object; review-docs.mjs requires docs.review.articleCritiques with exact path/hash/author/round/critics fields and lane names; review:info:52 reports config and criteria but no results shape.
findings.disposition: Corrected in both languages after the frozen third-round findings.
findings.verification: Both versions at119/123 assign report acquisition to maintainers, explain the results-file placeholder, name the five-lens object and docs.review fields, and link actual adapter, nested validator and test-format examples without presenting fixture data as real review.

findings.problem: The Linux setup downloads Chromium without installing its required system dependencies.
findings.consequence: A fresh supported Linux machine can reach npm test and fail before any browser test executes.
findings.evidence: Confirmed prerequisite omission from docs: Playwright documents install-deps or install --with-deps at https://playwright.dev/docs/browsers; knowledge/.github/workflows/pages.yml:34 already uses install --with-deps chromium. No fresh Linux execution was performed.
findings.disposition: Corrected in both languages after the frozen third-round findings.
findings.verification: Both versions at113 replace the Linux browser installation command with install --with-deps chromium, explain OS package privileges and link official Playwright browser documentation.
